title: When the Well Burns
author: Silas Dunmore
blurb: Kestrel Amberdale, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
